failure_case.observation: The model prioritized airplane-related captions describing aircraft in flight before retrieving the correct image captions.
The image has four meaningful giraffe captions and one non-descriptive caption. This may affect caption quality, but its causal impact has not been established.

limitations: Only two failure cases were inspected.
Visual inspection images were not available in the returned output.
The causal effect of the non-descriptive caption is unverified.
Results are from validation, not test.
